caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular box-like object with rounded corners and four small circular feet, rendered primarily in shades of gray, black, and white. The object features a central vertical panel or divider that rises from inside the box and appears slightly curved at the top; this divides the box into two compartments. Each compartment contains a circular, metallic-looking component with a central depression. The main view is presented in perspective, while two smaller inset diagrams are included: the upper right diagram shows a front elevation with dimension annotations ("6 7/8", "3 1/4", and "1 5/8"), and the lower left diagram shows a top-down view with an annotated width of "4". The drawing is signed “Holger Hansen” in the bottom right corner. The background is a light beige color, and the drawing is framed by a single-line border.
title: Pewter Inkwell
